call_protection_until.quote: at the Company’s option at any time, and from time to time, on or after March 5, 2027 and on or before the 20th scheduled trading day immediately before the maturity date,

provisional_call_condition.value: notes Freely Tradable and special/additional interest paid; last reported sale price EXCEEDS 130% of conversion price on each of >=20 of 30 consecutive trading days ending the day before notice AND on the trading day before notice; partial call only if >= $75.0M remains outstanding and not called
provisional_call_condition.quote: the last reported sale price per share of the Company’s class A common stock exceeds 130% of the conversion price on (1) each of at least 20 trading days, whether or not consecutive, during the 30 consecutive trading days

redemption_price.value: 100% of principal + accrued and unpaid special and additional interest
redemption_price.quote: The redemption price will be equal to the principal amount of the notes to be redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid special interest and additional interest, if any, to, but excluding, the redemption date.

holder_put_date.quote: Noteholders may require the Company to repurchase their notes on March 1, 2028, at a cash repurchase price equal to the principal amount of the notes to be repurchased,

holder_put_price.value: 100% of principal + accrued and unpaid special and additional interest
holder_put_price.quote: Noteholders may require the Company to repurchase their notes on March 1, 2028, at a cash repurchase price equal to the principal amount of the notes to be repurchased, plus accrued and unpaid special interest and additional interest,

conv_condition_stock_price.value: last reported sale price EXCEEDS 130% of conversion price for each of >=20 of last 30 consecutive trading days of preceding quarter; quarters commencing after 2025-06-30
conv_condition_stock_price.quote: commencing after the calendar quarter ending on June 30, 2025, if the Last Reported Sale Price per share of Class A Common Stock exceeds one hundred and thirty percent (130%) of the Conversion Price

fair_value_level.quote: specifically the last traded price at the end of the reporting period of identical instruments in the over-the-counter market (Level 2).

ranking.value: senior unsecured; senior to preferred equity; effectively subordinated to secured debt; structurally subordinated to subsidiaries

make_whole.value: yes (Make-Whole Fundamental Change incl. redemption notice, only for called notes)
make_whole.quote: In addition, calling any note for redemption will constitute a Make-Whole Fundamental Change with respect to that note, in which case the conversion rate applicable to the conversion of that note will be increased

settlement_method.value: cash, shares of class A common stock, or combination, at Company election (indenture Default Settlement Method = Physical Settlement)
settlement_method.quote: The Company will settle conversions by paying or delivering, as applicable, cash, shares of its class A common stock or a combination of cash and shares of its class A common stock, at the Company’s election.
